project_info.theme: Opening-week retail promotion for YSL Beauty Tien Bo
project_info.color_palette: White marble, black, gold, champagne beige

main_subject.detail: A front-facing render-style image of the YSL Beauty Tiến Bộ boutique kiosk with white marble walls, a black curved fascia, bright display counters, and large product visuals inside the store. Top text reads 'TUẦN LỄ KHAI TRƯƠNG' and 'YSL BEAUTY TIẾN BỘ'. Bottom sections include the location '175 NGUYỄN THÁI HỌC, BA ĐÌNH, HÀ NỘI', a Libre perfume bottle with 'TRẢI NGHIỆM NGAY LIBRE BÙNG NỔ TỰ DO TRONG TỪNG NỐT HƯƠNG', and a gold footer saying 'QUÀ TẶNG GIÁ TRỊ CHO 10 ĐƠN HÀNG ĐẦU TIÊN 13/02 - 15/02'.
main_subject.style: Luxury retail architectural promo, polished storefront visualization, high-end marble-and-black beauty branding

composition_elements.text: TUẦN LỄ KHAI TRƯƠNG, YSL BEAUTY TIẾN BỘ, 175 NGUYỄN THÁI HỌC, BA ĐÌNH, HÀ NỘI, TRẢI NGHIỆM NGAY, LIBRE, BÙNG NỔ TỰ DO TRONG TỪNG NỐT HƯƠNG, QUÀ TẶNG GIÁ TRỊ CHO 10 ĐƠN HÀNG ĐẦU TIÊN 13/02 - 15/02
items: Top Left: Opening-week label 'TUẦN LỄ KHAI TRƯƠNG' above large black headline text
Top Right: Vertical YSL BEAUTE logo in black
Bottom Left: Location pin icon, Hanoi address text, and a small Libre perfume bottle product insert
Bottom Right: Gift icons and a gold footer strip promoting the first 10 orders between 13/02 - 15/02
Center/Background: Front view of the YSL Beauty Tiến Bộ store kiosk with marble walls, black fascia, central display stand, and illuminated product posters

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean showroom illumination, glossy marble reflections, crisp signage visibility, premium architectural clarity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury retail-opening poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a photoreal front-facing YSL Beauty Tiến Bộ boutique kiosk with white marble walls, a black curved fascia, bright counters, and internal beauty posters. Include the exact text 'TUẦN LỄ KHAI TRƯƠNG', 'YSL BEAUTY TIẾN BỘ', '175 NGUYỄN THÁI HỌC, BA ĐÌNH, HÀ NỘI', 'TRẢI NGHIỆM NGAY', 'LIBRE', 'BÙNG NỔ TỰ DO TRONG TỪNG NỐT HƯƠNG', and 'QUÀ TẶNG GIÁ TRỊ CHO 10 ĐƠN HÀNG ĐẦU TIÊN 13/02 - 15/02'. Add a small Libre bottle insert near the lower-left and gift icons near the lower-right. Background is a white marble field integrated with the storefront. Technical style: photoreal retail-architecture advertising composite, bright luxury retail lighting, glossy marble reflections and crisp signage visibility, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
